title: The Need for a Socially-Grounded Persona Framework for User Simulation
reasoning: The SCOPE framework introduced in this paper explicitly includes 'Values & Motivations' as one of its eight core facets for constructing and evaluating personas. According to the paper, this facet captures 'moral orientation' and is used to predict 'moral reasoning' and 'social judgments'. Additionally, the framework includes religion as a foundational sociodemographic attribute.
